current_article.title: Celebrate Lunar New Year with Pokémon GO’s 2022 Lunar New Year event
current_article.text:
Updates
Celebrate Lunar New Year with Pokémon GO’s 2022 Lunar New Year event
Lunar New Year 2022
Tuesday, February 1, 2022, at 10:00 a.m. to Monday, February 7, 2022, at 8:00 p.m. local time
Shiny Litleo Leads the Pack
It’s time to celebrate Lunar New Year! Running at the front of the pack during the event is Litleo! If you’re lucky, you just might run into a Shiny Litleo for the first time in Pokémon GO!
Event Bonuses
Increased chance for Lucky Pokémon in trades
Increased chance to become Lucky Friends
Double Stardust from opening Gifts
1 extra special trade per day*
*Active from Monday, January 31, 2022, at 1:00 p.m. PST to Tuesday, February 8, 2022, at 1:00 p.m. PST (–8 GMT).
Wild Encounters
The following Pokémon will be appearing more frequently in the wild.
Also, for the first time in Pokémon GO, you’ll be able to encounter a Shiny Litleo, if you’re lucky!
Paras
Meowth
Growlithe
Voltorb
Hisuian Voltorb
Magikarp
Torchic
Litleo
If you’re lucky, you might encounter the following.
Electabuzz
Gyarados
Combusken
If you’re lucky, you may encounter a Shiny one!
Raids
The following Pokémon will be appearing in raids.
One-Star Raids
Magikarp
Shinx
Darumaka
Litleo
Espurr
Three-Star Raids
Charizard
Flareon
Shuckle
Delcatty
Absol
Druddigon
Five-Star Raids
Regirock*
Mega Raids
Mega Houndoom
*Regirock caught during this time will know the attack Earthquake
If you’re lucky, you may encounter a Shiny one!
Eggs
The following Pokémon will be hatching from Eggs obtained during the event.
7 Km Eggs
Shuckle
Slugma
Darumaka
Scraggy
Litleo
Field Research Task Encounters
The following Pokémon will be available to encounter when you complete Field Research tasks!
Alolan Meowth
Galarian Meowth
Magikarp
Darumaka
Litleo
Espurr
Complete certain Field Research tasks to earn Mega Energy for the following Pokémon.
Mega Gyarados Energy
If you’re lucky, you may encounter a Shiny one!
Timed Research
Two timed research challenges focused around catching and friendship will be available! Complete the Timed Research to earn:
Litleo
Espurr
